doctrine: N-Sites: the same fail-closed instrument on every free site; pull -> run -> push; INCOMPLETE never passes; one account per site; published free allowance only. Every site stages UNSIGNED bytes; MEASURED exists only after a VALID Ed25519 signature under did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1 verifies. A rank is never sold.
source_note: Copy of the operator's nsites_sites.json doctrine (corpus-watch is another lane's repo and is not written from here). The corpus-watch file was not present on this machine at copy time; this entry is the first site registered in-repo.

hf_jobs.push: csoai/gspc-hub-cards staged-unsigned/<date>/<axis>/ + MANIFEST.json (UNSIGNED only; never mill-cards/, INDEX.jsonl, cards.jsonl or hub-queue)
hf_jobs.schedule_note: daily, not hourly - inference is org prepaid
hf_jobs.schedule_id: PENDING - filled by the owner step in the PR body after `hf jobs scheduled run`
hf_jobs.account: one account per site: the org-scoped HF token in the scheduled job's HF_TOKEN secret
fail_closed: inference balance/credit error -> exit 3 and HALTED-BALANCE in MANIFEST
any axis mill rc != 0 -> INCOMPLETE, exit 4

lid_source: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc totals.lid (quoted verbatim, never typed)
